add.title: Anduril, US Navy to invest $6.6B in Arsenal-2 submarine shipyard in Maryland
add.blurb: Anduril commits $3.7B of private capital to Arsenal-2 at Tradepoint Atlantic (Sparrows Point, Baltimore County); the Navy awards a contract worth up to $2.9B tied to production outcomes. About 3,100 direct jobs; initial operations targeted for 2030.
add.note: Confirmed by the company and the Maryland governor's office; Reuters wire carried by Military Times.
